title: Finite-free coefficient-system towers and normalized geometric comparison data
statement:
Fix a universe $u$, a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,L$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ in universe $u+1$, and a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra embedding $i:E\to L$. Use the valuation rings and chosen uniformizers of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] and the actual integer inclusion $i_{\mathcal O}$ of [def-weil-pbc-integer-quotient-inclusions]. For $n\in\mathbf N$, define
$$A_n=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi_E)^{n+1},\qquad B_n=\mathcal O_L/(i_{\mathcal O}(\varpi_E))^{n+1}.$$
Their successor transition maps are induced by the identity on the respective integer rings; the compatible level map $A_n\to B_n$ is $[a]\mapsto[i_{\mathcal O}(a)]$. For every scheme $X$ in universe $u$, apply constant sheafification and the sectionwise system-map construction of [def-coef-semilinear-system-models] to obtain the ring-system inclusion $A_{\bullet,X}\to B_{\bullet,X}$ on the small pro-etale sequence site of [def-sp-semilinear-constant-ring-operations]. Define $U_X^0$ to be restriction along this inclusion and $U_X=DU_X^0$ its termwise localization. Define the lower-coefficient module $B_{\bullet,X}$ by restriction of the upper unit module.

Let $D$ be the global finite-field datum of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], with algebraically closed field $k$. Define $\mathrm{Spaces}(D)$ as the objects $X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ whose structure maps are separated [def-weil-proper-morphism], locally of finite type and quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Maps between their underlying schemes are not required to be over $k$. For such a map $f:X\to Y$, define an ordinary scalar square to be isomorphisms
$$f_{*,B}^0U_Y^0\cong U_X^0f_{*,A}^0,\qquad f_B^{*,0}U_X^0\cong U_Y^0f_A^{*,0},$$
written in diagrammatic functor order, where the first is identity on every underlying section group $M_n(V\times_YX)$ and is the right mate of the inverse of the second under the specified ordinary adjunctions [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. Define its derived pullback comparison by exact localization; define its derived direct-image comparison as the geometric right mate of its inverse; for an open immersion define its inverse open-extension comparison as the open-adjunction mate of the derived pullback comparison. All operations and adjunctions here are those of [def-sp-semilinear-constant-ring-operations].

Define $\mathrm{Geometry}(\ell,E,L,i,D)$ to consist of these ordinary squares for every map between objects of $\mathrm{Spaces}(D)$, proofs that their derived direct-image comparisons and open-extension mates are invertible, and the coefficient morphisms $B_{\bullet,Y}\to f_{*,A}^0B_{\bullet,X}$ whose sections are the actual constant-coefficient structural maps, with invertible ordinary pullback adjuncts. Define $\mathrm{pushIso}$ by the specified invertible derived right mate and $\mathrm{openIso}$ by the inverse of the specified invertible open mate. This defines a type of normalized comparison data; it asserts no existence of an inhabitant.

For $G$ of this type, define $\mathrm{Compatibility}(G)$ as the proposition that $U$ preserves, through these very comparisons, the proper, pullback and open identity maps and compositors, the clopen projector, the Cartesian open comparison $\beta$ and intrinsic proper/open comparison $\alpha$ of [def-sf-semilinear-proper-open-comparisons], and the right-adjoint mate $\gamma$ of [def-coef-semilinear-proper-open-mate]. Each preservation equation equates applying $U$ to the upper-coefficient generator and then using the comparison at its target with first using the comparison at its source and then the lower-coefficient generator; quantification is over every appropriate scheme map, square and entire derived-system object, with precisely the geometric hypotheses of the indicated generators. Finally, for any ring tower $(C,\tau)$ and open immersion $j:X\hookrightarrow W$ followed by a scheme map $p:W\to Y$, define $\mathrm{compact}(C,\tau,j,p)=J_jR_p$ in diagrammatic order. For $G$ as above, its compact scalar-restriction isomorphism is obtained by first commuting restriction past $R_p$ using $\mathrm{pushIso}$ and then past $J_j$ using $\mathrm{openIso}$, with the canonical functor associators. All this data lives on ordinary unbounded derived categories of entire strict systems, before evaluation or inverse limit; no basis, ramification index, or scalar-restriction existence theorem is part of the definition.

lean.note: Definition owner requested by H2 of independent review of returned head 75b30eb5bce5. Reuses the published definitions verbatim, including the normalized ordinary squares, canonical derived mates, their conditional invertibility data, and Compatibility proposition. No Assertions or finiteFreeSystemRestriction theorem is recorded or assumed; levelMap_transition is the existing quotient-map compatibility helper. No Lean source is copied or rewritten. H3: moved to a separate data module, publicly re-exported by the original module. U retains its body with its definitionally equal proper/open derived-category functor type written explicitly; it is reducible and shares the explicit category types in the coherence proof. The generic component constructors compactScalarIso and compactWord construct the same proper/open comparison and word, with directly proved naturality; the concrete definitions instantiate them. Other moved signatures and bodies stay verbatim. This representation avoids repeated large categorical conversions in the coherence proof.
